detail.longDescription: I ran a small test on my garden: four agent setups, nine tasks, one question - whose words are these? With only Claude's summaries of what I'd read, it invented my opinions. Of 17 views it gave me, 6 were Claude's own words with my name on them, traced back to my own notes. With my verdicts kept apart: 64 of 64 correct. Do you ideate with agents? How do you guard against choice blindness? https:// latentmirror.com/posts/the-ver dict-layer-test/ # LLM # AIAgents # Claude
